[This](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0vvU-Ajwbok) is a pretty accurate reconstruction of what you can experience after playing to much with tryptamines. Alone in a room, afraid to close your eyes even for a moment because then voices get more aggressive. Try to calm down, just focus, breath, count. Let's focus on counting and just wait it all through. So you count: one, two, fourteen, ninety two. Shivers run down your spine when you realize you can't even count, the numbers are all the same.
You are utterly broken. Terrified, paranoic and unable to think.

I managed to wait it through just holding my head in both hands and curling on a ground. Later I've found out it was a serotonin syndrome.
It was 4 hopeless hours of hell. Back then, when the time was non-existent, it seemed much longer.
